title: WNM-3D: A World Navigation Model with 3D Scene Conditioning for Closed-Loop VLN
summary: Recent vision-language navigation (VLN) systems increasingly adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) into vision-language-action (VLA) policies that map egocentric observations and language instructions directly to navigation actions. Although semantically capable, such action-centric training does not explicitly model how the agent's visual observations should evolve under its predicted motion. Generative world-action models (WAMs) jointly predict future observations and actions, yet existing WAMs for continuous VLN do not condition joint future-view and action generation on geometry-aware representations inferred from the observed history. We present WNM-3D, a generative World Navigation Model with 3D scene conditioning for continuous VLN. To consolidate past observations into persistent scene context, a frozen feed-forward geometry encoder extracts geometry-aware representations from the monocular egocentric RGB history, and a trainable 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter converts them into a fixed-length prefix in the token space of the world-action Diffusion Transformer. Through block-causal attention, this prefix conditions every future video-action block, providing a shared geometric context for both future-view and action generation. We train WNM-3D through supervised world-action fine-tuning on A*-generated demonstrations, DAgger-style adaptation on policy-visited states, and DanceGRPO-based closed-loop policy optimization. Experiments on GN-Bench show that WNM-3D outperforms strong VLM-based navigation policies and its 2D-conditioned counterpart in closed-loop navigation. On a fixed near-goal evaluation set, WNM-3D also achieves higher flow-action consistency and lower visual-motion error.
tldr: WNM-3D proposes a generative world navigation model with 3D scene conditioning for continuous vision-language navigation, using a frozen geometry encoder and a 3D Scene-to-Token Adapter to produce geometry-aware context that conditions joint future-view and action generation via a Diffusion Transformer, achieving superior closed-loop navigation on GN-Bench.
tldr_zh: WNM-3D提出了一种具有三维场景条件生成的世界导航模型，用于连续视觉语言导航，通过冻结的几何编码器和三维场景到令牌适配器生成几何感知上下文，并利用扩散变换器条件化联合未来视图和动作生成，在GN-Bench上实现了更优的闭环导航。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
近年来，视觉-语言导航（VLN）系统越来越多地将预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）适配为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，直接将第一人称视角观测与语言指令映射为导航动作。尽管此类以动作为中心的训练具备语义能力，但它并未显式建模在预测运动下智能体视觉观测应如何演变。生成式世界-动作模型（WAM）能联合预测未来观测与动作，然而现有的针对连续VLN的WAM未能将未来视角与动作的联合生成，基于从观测历史推断出的几何感知表示进行条件建模。我们提出WNM-3D，一种具备3D场景条件的生成式世界导航模型，用于连续VLN。为将历史观测整合为持续的场境上下文，一个冻结的前馈几何编码器从单目第一人称视角RGB历史中提取几何感知表示，一个可训练的3D场景-令牌适配器将其转换为世界-动作扩散Transformer令牌空间中的定长前缀。通过块因果注意力机制，该前缀对每个未来视频-动作块进行条件建模，为未来视角与动作生成提供共享的几何上下文。我们通过在A*生成的示范数据上进行有监督的世界-动作微调、在策略访问状态上进行DAgger风格自适应，以及基于DanceGRPO的闭环策略优化来训练WNM-3D。在GN-Bench上的实验表明，WNM-3D在闭环导航中优于基于VLM的强基线导航策略及其2D条件对应版本。在一个固定的近目标评估集上，WNM-3D还实现了更高的流-动作一致性以及更低的视觉-运动误差。

title: Cross-View Action Consistency for Camera-Robust Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies fine-tuned from a fixed scene camera can fail when the camera is moved, even when the task, objects, language, and robot state are unchanged. We study scene-camera viewpoint robustness using only a scene RGB image, language, and proprioception, without camera labels, extrinsics, depth, or point-cloud inputs. The wrist stream is masked throughout to prevent an unperturbed visual shortcut from confounding attribution to scene-camera variation. For flow-based VLAs, we propose to regularize the action-flow velocity field, the quantity directly integrated to generate continuous action chunks. We construct action-equivalent view pairs by resetting original LIBERO demonstrations to the same MuJoCo state and rendering nominal and perturbed scene-camera views. Both views are supervised by flow matching, while a cross-view loss encourages their predicted action-flow velocities to agree at the same sampled flow coordinates. On the LIBERO-Plus camera-perturbation track, our method reaches 87.2$\pm$0.4% (4,797 rollouts per seed across 3 training seeds), +7.4pp over flow-matching-only training on the same paired data (79.8$\pm$0.8%, also 3 seeds) and +12.5pp over naive mixed-camera SFT, while maintaining nominal-camera ID performance (95.0$\pm$0.8%; same-data FM-only: 95.0$\pm$4.3%). A shuffled-pair control collapses to 25.8%, showing that the gain depends on action-equivalent pairing. On a real robot, we evaluate three tabletop tasks with 10 rollouts per task and camera placement; held-out-camera success improves from 53.3% to 74.4% under the same single-scene-RGB inference interface.
tldr: This paper proposes a cross-view action consistency regularization for flow-based VLA policies to improve robustness to scene camera viewpoint changes, achieving significant gains on LIBERO-Plus and real-robot tabletop tasks without camera metadata or depth.
tldr_zh: 本文针对基于流的VLA策略提出跨视角动作一致性正则化方法，在不依赖相机元数据或深度的情况下显著提升对场景相机视角变化的鲁棒性，在LIBERO-Plus和真实机器人桌面任务上取得显著提升。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略若从固定的场景摄像机微调而来，当摄像机移动时可能失效，即使任务、物体、语言和机器人状态均保持不变。本文仅利用场景RGB图像、语言和本体感知信息研究场景摄像机视角鲁棒性，无需摄像机标签、外参、深度或点云输入。全程屏蔽腕部数据流，以防止未受干扰的视觉捷径干扰对场景摄像机变化的归因分析。针对基于流的VLA模型，我们提出对动作流速度场（即直接积分生成连续动作块的变量）进行正则化。通过将原始LIBERO演示重置至相同的MuJoCo状态，并渲染标称与扰动场景摄像机视角，构建动作等价视角对。两个视角均通过流匹配进行监督，同时引入跨视角损失函数，强制两者在同一采样流坐标处的预测动作流速度保持一致。在LIBERO-Plus摄像机扰动测试集上，本方法达到87.2±0.4%（3个训练种子各执行4,797次 rollout），较仅使用相同配对数据进行流匹配训练的基线（79.8±0.8%，同样3个种子）提升7.4个百分点，较朴素混合摄像机SFT提升12.5个百分点，同时保持标称摄像机的ID性能（95.0±0.8%；相同数据下纯流匹配训练为95.0±4.3%）。随机配对对照实验的性能骤降至25.8%，表明性能提升依赖于动作等价配对。在真实机器人实验中，我们评估三项桌面任务（每项任务及摄像机布局各执行10次 rollout），在相同单场景RGB推理接口下，保留摄像机的任务成功率从53.3%提升至74.4%。

title: AtlasVLA: Persistent World-Ego State Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced embodied AI, their fundamentally reactive paradigm severely limits performance in partially observable and long-horizon tasks. When restricted to a single wrist-mounted camera, they inevitably suffer from perception forgetting as objects exit the field of view, and temporal task-progress forgetting} during multi-step execution. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose AtlasVLA, a novel framework that transitions from direct reactive manipulation to proactive reasoning through a persistent world-ego state. AtlasVLA features a dual-memory architecture: a 4D Persistent World State Memory that lifts transient 2D observations into a globally updated, voxel-hashed spatial state to resolve visual blind spots, and an Ego-Working State Memory that tracks historical ego state and task progress. By conditioning a diffusion transformer (DiT) on this joint World-Ego state, AtlasVLA enables robust spatial reasoning. Extensive evaluations across LIBERO, RLBench, and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that AtlasVLA achieves state-of-the-art performance using solely a wrist camera. Remarkably, it decisively outperforms multi-view baselines, yielding absolute success rate improvements of 9.4% on LIBERO-Long and 17.5% in real-world long-horizon tasks.
tldr: AtlasVLA introduces a dual-memory architecture (4D persistent world state and ego-working state) to overcome reactive limitations in VLA models, achieving SOTA performance in long-horizon tasks with a single wrist camera.
tldr_zh: AtlasVLA 提出了双记忆架构（4D 持久世界状态和自我工作状态），以克服 VLA 模型在反应式范式中的局限性，在仅使用腕部摄像头的长程任务中取得了 SOTA 性能。
summary_zh: 尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推动了具身人工智能的发展，但其本质上被动的反应范式严重限制了在部分可观测及长时域任务中的表现。当仅依赖单台腕部相机时，这类模型不可避免地会面临物体离开视野导致的感知遗忘问题，以及在多步骤执行过程中出现的时序任务进度遗忘问题。为突破这些瓶颈，我们提出AtlasVLA——一种通过持久化世界-自我状态实现从直接反应式操控向主动推理转变的新型框架。AtlasVLA采用双记忆架构：4D持久化世界状态记忆将瞬态2D观测数据提升为全局更新的体素哈希空间状态，从而消除视觉盲区；自我工作状态记忆则记录历史自我状态与任务进度。通过将条件扩散变换器（DiT）作用于联合世界-自我状态，AtlasVLA实现了稳健的空间推理能力。在LIBERO、RLBench及真实世界基准测试中的广泛评估表明，仅使用腕部相机的AtlasVLA达到了当前最优性能。值得注意的是，它显著超越了多视角基线方法，在LIBERO-Long任务中实现9.4%的绝对成功率提升，在真实世界长时域任务中提升幅度达17.5%。

title: SimWAM: A Simple World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve end-to-end autonomous driving by transferring video dynamics priors to action prediction, but existing methods require costly future generation at inference. We present SimWAM, a simple yet effective WAM that uses video generation purely as a training signal. It co-trains a pretrained video expert and a lightweight action expert with joint flow matching. An isolated attention mask keeps action prediction independent of future frames, allowing the video branch to be discarded after training and leaving a self-contained planner that directly predicts trajectories. Since the two experts share no parameters and interact only through a unified attention interface, the video backbone could be replaced and the action expert scaled independently without modifying the learning objective or inference pipeline. We further apply reinforcement learning to optimize a compositional driving reward beyond trajectory imitation. Our SimWAM achieves $91.5$ PDMS on NAVSIM, surpasses state-of-the-art WAM-based planners with substantially lower latency, and transfers zero-shot to nuScenes. These results position SimWAM as a simple yet solid baseline that could readily benefit from advances in video generation for efficient autonomous driving. The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/SimWAM/
tldr: SimWAM proposes a simple world action model for autonomous driving that uses video generation only as a training signal, discarding the video branch at inference to achieve low-latency, state-of-the-art trajectory prediction.
tldr_zh: SimWAM 提出一种简单的世界动作模型，在训练时仅将视频生成作为信号，推理时丢弃视频分支，实现低延迟、领先的自动驾驶轨迹预测。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）通过将视频动态先验迁移至动作预测，提升了端到端自动驾驶的性能，但现有方法在推理时仍需进行成本高昂的未来帧生成。我们提出SimWAM——一种简洁而有效的WAM，它仅将视频生成作为训练信号。该方法通过联合流匹配，协同训练一个预训练的视频专家与一个轻量级的动作专家。隔离注意力机制确保动作预测独立于未来帧，使得视频分支在训练后可被舍弃，留下一个能够直接预测轨迹的独立规划器。由于两个专家不共享参数，仅通过统一的注意力接口交互，因此视频骨干网络可被替换，动作专家也可独立缩放，而无需修改学习目标或推理流程。我们进一步应用强化学习，优化一种超越轨迹模仿的组合式驾驶奖励。SimWAM在NAVSIM上达到了91.5的PDMS指标，以显著更低的延迟超越了基于WAM的现有最优规划器，并零样本迁移至nuScenes数据集。这些结果表明SimWAM可作为一个简洁而稳健的基线，其能够直接受益于视频生成技术的进步，用于高效自动驾驶。代码与模型权重已开源至https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/SimWAM/。

title: Depth-Wise Probing and Pruning of the Planning Token in a Driving Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models route driving decisions through a deep language model, but it is unclear how much of that depth the action itself requires. We study a representative driving VLA whose entire plan is carried by a single planning token that a generative planner decodes into a trajectory. Borrowing the planner as a trajectory-space logit lens, we decode the planning token from every one of the 32 decoder layers and measure two signals: the linear decodability of the navigation command and trajectory compatibility with the frozen native planner. Our diagnostic shows that semantic intent is linearly decodable early: command-probe accuracy reaches 97.7\% after the first decoder layer, compared with 16.7\% chance. In contrast, compatibility with the frozen native planner improves gradually across depth, with open-loop Avg-L2 reaching its minimum of 2.11\,m only at the final layer. Learned readouts from the first layer recover much of this gap, indicating that planning information is already present early but is not yet represented in the format expected by the deployed planner. Ranking decoder layers by the angular deviation they induce in the planning token permits removal of 8 of 32 layers within an approximately 5\% relative open-loop error increase and yields a measured 1.33$\times$ decoder speedup. At the evaluated sample size, no family-specific degradation is statistically resolved. These findings are limited to the evaluated ORION checkpoint and Bench2Drive setup.
tldr: This paper systematically probes the planning token across layers of a driving VLA model, revealing that semantic intent is linearly decodable early while trajectory compatibility improves gradually with depth, and demonstrates a pruning strategy that removes 8 of 32 decoder layers with minimal accuracy loss.
tldr_zh: 本文系统性地探测了驾驶VLA模型各层的规划token，发现语义意图可在早期线性解码，而轨迹兼容性随深度逐步改善，并提出了一种移除8/32解码器层且精度损失极小的剪枝策略。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过深度语言模型进行驾驶决策，但动作本身对语言模型深度的需求尚不明确。本研究以具代表性的驾驶VLA为对象，其完整规划由生成式规划器解码单个规划令牌为轨迹。利用该规划器作为轨迹空间的对数概率透镜，我们从全部32个解码器层分别解码该规划令牌，并测量两类信号：导航命令的线性可解码性，以及与冻结原生规划器的轨迹兼容性。诊断结果表明：语义意图在早期即具有线性可解码性——首个解码器层后的命令探测准确率达97.7%，而随机概率仅为16.7%。相反，与冻结原生规划器的兼容性随深度逐步提升，开环平均L2误差仅在最终层达到最小值2.11米。对首层学习得到的读出结果可大幅弥补该差距，表明规划信息已存在于早期层但尚未以部署规划器所要求的格式表达。依据规划令牌角度偏差对解码器层排序后，可在开环误差相对增加约5%的情况下移除32层中的8层，实测解码器加速比达1.33倍。在评估样本规模下，未检测到任何族类特异性降级具有统计显著性。上述结论仅限于所评估的ORION检查点及Bench2Drive实验设置。

title: TEMPO: Semantic-Action Decoupled RL Post-Training for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are commonly adapted to downstream manipulation tasks via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or online reinforcement learning (RL) post-training. SFT is prone to distribution mismatch, and existing RL approaches typically apply a single, uniform update strategy to all model components, ignoring their distinct functional roles. We propose TEMPO, a semantic-action decoupled, two-timescale RL post-training framework for VLA models. TEMPO freezes the pretrained vision-language backbone to preserve general semantic representations, and restricts adaptation to two components with dedicated RL optimization loops: the semantic projection layer and the low-level action expert. We update them at different rates--the semantic projection layer infrequently, to keep the latent action stable, and the action expert frequently, to rapidly incorporate control feedback from online interaction. This decoupling RL fine-tuning strategy prevents fast policy updates from destabilizing high-level semantic representations while still allowing the action expert to learn efficiently from online feedback. Experiments on the CALVIN benchmark and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that TEMPO consistently outperforms both pretrained state-of-the-art VLA models and the RL post-training baseline, while reaching and maintaining higher evaluation rewards on two real-world tasks.
tldr: Proposes a decoupled two-timescale RL post-training method for VLA models that freezes the vision-language backbone and updates the semantic projection and action expert at different rates, achieving better performance on manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种针对VLA模型的解耦双时间尺度RL后训练方法，冻结视觉语言骨干，以不同速率更新语义投影层和动作专家，在操作任务上取得更好性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常通过监督微调（SFT）或在线强化学习（RL）后训练来适配下游操作任务。SFT容易产生分布不匹配问题，而现有RL方法通常对所有模型组件采用单一的、统一的更新策略，忽视了它们各自不同的功能角色。我们提出TEMPO，一种面向VLA模型的语义-动作解耦双时间尺度RL后训练框架。TEMPO冻结预训练的视觉-语言骨干网络以保留通用语义表征，并将适配限制为两个具有专属RL优化循环的组件：语义投影层和底层动作专家。我们以不同速率更新二者——语义投影层低频更新以保持潜在动作的稳定性，动作专家高频更新以快速融入来自在线交互的控制反馈。这种解耦式RL微调策略既能防止快速策略更新破坏高层语义表征的稳定性，又能使动作专家高效地从在线反馈中学习。在CALVIN基准测试和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，TEMPO在持续优于预训练的最先进VLA模型及RL后训练基线的同时，还在两项真实任务中达到并维持了更高的评估奖励。

title: LifelongCrossNav: Persistent 3D Semantic Memory for Cross-Floor Multi-Object Navigation
summary: Object-goal navigation has made substantial progress in semantic perception and exploration, yet persistent memory for multi-object navigation and cross-floor navigation are still commonly addressed separately. We present LifelongCrossNav, a framework for sequential multi-object ObjectNav in unknown multi-floor indoor environments. Within each episode, the agent receives an ordered sequence of object-goal queries while continuously maintaining a shared sparse 3D semantic voxel memory. This memory incrementally accumulates geometric structure, traversability states, and vision-language features, allowing subsequent object-goal queries to retrieve previously acquired scene information without rebuilding the map. To support persistent search across floors, LifelongCrossNav combines support-aware 3D traversability mapping, stair-specific perception, and direction-aware stair traversal. A unified navigation policy coordinates same-floor frontier exploration, live and historical point-of-interest retrieval, stair navigation, and target-object search and approach. We further introduce HM3D-MFMON, a benchmark for sequential Multi-Floor Multi-Object Navigation built on HM3D scenes, including a dedicated subset in which completing the full sequence of object-goal subtasks requires at least one floor transition. Experimental results show that LifelongCrossNav consistently outperforms a representative planar persistent semantic-map baseline on HM3D-MFMON, demonstrating that persistent 3D semantic memory and cross-floor traversability modeling effectively support sequential multi-object navigation in multi-floor environments. Project page: https://flageval-baai.github.io/LifelongCrossNavPage.
tldr: LifelongCrossNav proposes a persistent 3D semantic voxel memory framework for sequential multi-object navigation across unknown multi-floor indoor environments, introducing a benchmark for multi-floor multi-object navigation.
tldr_zh: LifelongCrossNav 提出了一个持久化3D语义体素记忆框架，用于在未知的多楼层室内环境中进行连续多目标导航，并引入了多楼层多目标导航基准。
summary_zh: 摘要：面向目标的导航在语义感知与探索方面取得了显著进展，但多目标导航中的持久记忆与跨楼层导航通常仍被分开处理。我们提出LifelongCrossNav，一个用于未知多楼层室内环境中序贯多目标导航的框架。在每个任务回合中，智能体接收一组有序的目标查询序列，并持续维护一个共享的稀疏三维语义体素记忆。该记忆逐步累积几何结构、可通行状态及视觉-语言特征，使得后续目标查询能够检索之前获取的场景信息而无需重建地图。为支持跨楼层的持续搜索，LifelongCrossNav结合了支持感知的三维可通行性建图、楼梯专用感知以及方向感知的楼梯通行策略。一个统一的导航策略协调同层前沿探索、实时与历史兴趣点检索、楼梯导航以及目标物体的搜索与靠近。我们进一步引入HM3D-MFMON，一个基于HM3D场景构建的序贯多楼层多目标导航基准，其中包含一个专用子集：在该子集中，完成全部目标子任务序列至少需要一次楼层切换。实验结果表明，LifelongCrossNav在HM3D-MFMON上持续优于具有代表性的平面持久语义地图基线，证明了持久三维语义记忆与跨楼层可通行性建模能有效支持多楼层环境中的序贯多目标导航。项目页面：https://flageval-baai.github.io/LifelongCrossNavPage。

title: C2Dex: Contact-Consistent Reconstruction and Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation from Monocular Video
summary: High-quality demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation are costly and difficult to collect, whereas monocular human videos provide a scalable source of diverse manipulation behaviors. However, transferring such demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging: monocular hand-object interaction (HOI) reconstruction often produces temporally unstable contacts and physically implausible interactions, while conventional retargeting methods struggle to preserve task-relevant contacts and local interaction geometry across different hand embodiments. We present C2Dex, a video-to-dexterous-manipulation framework built around a shared interaction representation: stable object-side contacts recovered by aggregating noisy frame-wise observations in the canonical object space. These stable contacts serve a dual role: as trajectory-level constraints that guide reconstruction toward temporally coherent and physically plausible human HOI trajectories, and as explicit transfer targets for the dexterous hand, where Laplacian interaction optimization preserves the local hand-object geometry across embodiments and residual reinforcement learning refines the trajectory in simulation. Experiments on DexYCB and TACO show that C2Dex achieves end-to-end trajectory success rates of 57.78% and 26.67%, respectively, substantially outperforming the strongest baselines (17.78% and 10.00%) under identical evaluation criteria. Real-robot replay experiments further demonstrate physical feasibility across diverse contact-rich manipulation tasks. Project page: https://k-jie.github.io/C2Dex/
tldr: C2Dex reconstructs temporally consistent, physically plausible hand-object interactions from monocular video by aggregating noisy observations in canonical object space, then retargets these interactions to dexterous robot hands via Laplacian optimization and residual RL, achieving high success rates in simulation and real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: C2Dex通过在规范对象空间中聚合噪声观测，从单目视频中重建时间一致、物理合理的手-物体交互，然后通过拉普拉斯优化和残差强化学习将这些交互迁移到灵巧机器人手上，在仿真和真实机器人实验中取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 高精度灵巧机器人操作示范的采集成本高昂且困难，而单目人类视频则提供了可扩展的多样化操作行为来源。然而，将此类示范迁移至灵巧机器人仍具挑战性：单目手-物交互（HOI）重建常产生时间上不稳定的接触和物理上不可信的交互，而传统重定向方法难以在不同手部形态间保留任务相关接触与局部交互几何结构。我们提出C2Dex——一个基于共享交互表示的视频到灵巧操作框架：通过在规范物体空间中聚合含噪声的逐帧观测，恢复稳定的物体侧接触点。这些稳定接触发挥双重作用：一方面作为轨迹级约束，引导重建生成时间连贯且物理合理的人类HOI轨迹；另一方面作为灵巧手的显式迁移目标，通过拉普拉斯交互优化保留跨形态的局部手-物几何结构，并借助残差强化学习在仿真中精修轨迹。在DexYCB和TACO上的实验表明，C2Dex分别实现了57.78%和26.67%的端到端轨迹成功率，在相同评估标准下显著超越最强基线（17.78%和10.00%）。真实机器人复现实验进一步验证了该方法在多种密集接触操作任务中的物理可行性。项目主页：https://k-jie.github.io/C2Dex/

title: Real-time Whole-Body Motion Planning for Mobile Manipulators Carrying Arbitrarily Shaped Payloads via Kinematically-Coupled SVSDF
summary: Mobile manipulators are increasingly tasked with transporting large, non-convex payloads through cluttered environments, yet existing planners either oversimplify the payload geometry or fail to handle the kinematic coupling between manipulator links, leading to lost feasible space or stalled optimization. This letter presents a real-time whole-body motion planning framework for mobile manipulators carrying arbitrarily shaped payloads. The front-end employs a chain-decomposed kernel-based collision check that preserves the true geometry of the robot and payload, with compact storage and fast bit-level queries. A mid-end preprocessing stage converts the front-end path into a continuous trajectory enforcing smoothness and feasibility, and executes it directly when collision-free to bypass the costly back-end. When refinement is required, the back-end performs trajectory optimization built on a Kinematically-Coupled SVSDF (KC-SVSDF), which propagates collision-avoidance gradients along the kinematic chain to produce coherent whole-body escape directions. Ablation studies, comparative benchmarks against state-of-the-art baselines, and real-world experiments on a differential-drive mobile manipulator demonstrate that the proposed framework reliably transports large, non-convex payloads through tight passages and cluttered environments.
tldr: This paper presents a real-time whole-body motion planning framework for mobile manipulators carrying arbitrarily shaped payloads, using chain-decomposed collision checks and a Kinematically-Coupled SVSDF for trajectory optimization.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于携带任意形状负载的移动机械臂的实时全身运动规划框架，采用链式分解碰撞检测和运动耦合SVSDF进行轨迹优化。
summary_zh: 移动机械臂日益需要将大型非凸负载搬运穿越杂乱环境，但现有规划器要么过度简化负载几何形状，要么无法处理机械臂连杆间的运动学耦合，导致可行空间丢失或优化停滞。本文提出一种适用于搬运任意形状负载的移动机械臂实时全身运动规划框架。前端采用基于链式分解的核碰撞检测技术，在保留机器人与负载真实几何特性的同时实现紧凑存储与快速位级查询。中端预处理阶段将前端路径转化为连续轨迹，确保平滑性与可行性，当无碰撞时直接执行该轨迹以绕过昂贵的后端处理。若需优化，后端基于运动学耦合SVSDF（KC-SVSDF）进行轨迹优化，通过沿运动学链传播避碰梯度，生成连贯的全身避障方向。消融实验、与最优基线方法的对比基准测试，以及在差速驱动移动机械臂上开展的真实世界实验表明，本文框架能够在狭窄通道与杂乱环境中可靠地运输大型非凸负载。

title: Decoupling Intention from Trajectory: A Representational Deduction Framework for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) aim to construct a unified architecture capable of understanding world state evolution and guiding to generative motion planning. However, existing visual branches focus on predicting static visual observation, rather than reflecting potential transition information that captures the evolution of world states under motion interactions. This leads to representational entanglement between high-level physical condition evolution and low-level action trajectory generation within the Action Model, creating a structural bottleneck while weakening the predictive capability of world evolution modeling for action generation. We propose PILOT (Physical Inference for Latent Optimized Trajectories), whose core Representational Deduction (RD) bridges this gap by integrating motion thought-of-chain (CoT) guidance as a native model capability. Specifically, RD aims to encourage the action branch to explicitly model potential state transition tokens, which are retained as CoT in the reasoning space to guide fine-grained motion trajectory. Experiments demonstrate that RD not only significantly improves the success rate and generalization ability of WAMs in complex robotic manipulation tasks but also enhances the model's physical interpretability by decoupling high-level motion semantics from low-level trajectory details. Furthermore, the abundant state transition supervision signals introduced by RD effectively alleviate the sparse supervision in action generation, enabling it to serve as an efficient few-shot real-robot fine-tuning strategy and demonstrating superior scalability for migration to mainstream WAM architectures.
tldr: PILOT proposes a Representational Deduction framework that decouples high-level intention from low-level trajectory in World Action Models using chain-of-thought guidance, improving success rates, generalization, and physical interpretability in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: PILOT 提出了一种表示演绎框架，通过思维链引导将世界动作模型中的高层意图与低层轨迹解耦，提升了机器人操作的成功率、泛化能力和物理可解释性。
summary_zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）旨在构建能够理解世界状态演化并指导生成式运动规划的统⼀架构。然⽽，现有视觉分支专注于预测静态视觉观测，⽽未能反映捕捉运动交互下世界状态演化的潜在转移信息。这导致动作模型内部⾼层物理状态演化与底层动作轨迹⽣成之间的表征纠缠，形成结构性瓶颈，同时削弱了世界演化建模对动作⽣成的预测能⼒。我们提出PILOT（潜在轨迹优化的物理推理⽅法），其核⼼的表征演绎（RD）通过将运动思维链（CoT）引导作为模型原⽣能⼒来弥合这⼀差距。具体⽽⾔，RD旨在促使动作分支显式建模潜在状态转移标记，这些标记在推理空间中作为CoT保留以指导细粒度的运动轨迹。实验表明，RD不仅显著提升了WAMs在复杂机器⼈操作任务中的成功率和泛化能⼒，还通过将⾼层运动语义与底层轨迹细节解耦，增强了模型的物理可解释性。此外，RD引⼊的丰富状态转移监督信号有效缓解了动作⽣成中的稀疏监督问题，使其可作为⾼效的少样本真实机器⼈微调策略，并展现出迁移⾄主流WAM架构的卓越可扩展性。

title: Unordered Landmark Visual Navigation
summary: Image-goal navigation is a fundamental capability for embodied AI, yet its practical deployment is strained by strong prior assumptions. Existing methods predominantly rely on temporally ordered video streams or auxiliary sensors (e.g., depth, LiDAR) to maintain spatial consistency. These sequential and multimodal dependencies severely restrict scalability, especially when deploying robots using crowd-sourced or pre-recorded unordered image collections. When temporal priors are removed, current methods struggle with severe perceptual aliasing, noisy associations, and catastrophic mapping failures. To address this underexplored challenge, we propose Unordered Landmark Visual Navigation (ULVN), a unified RGB-only framework free from temporal and odometric priors. ULVN systematically mitigates error accumulation by integrating mapping, localization, and planning. Specifically, it constructs a robust 2D topological map directly from unstructured images via calibrated geometric verification and maximum spanning forest refinement. For closed-loop execution, ULVN abandons sequential heuristics, utilizing a graph-based belief propagation filter with entropy-adaptive fusion for global localization and dynamic subgoal planning. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world deployments demonstrate that ULVN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
tldr: ULVN proposes a unified RGB-only framework for image-goal navigation that removes the need for temporal ordering or auxiliary sensors by constructing robust 2D topological maps from unordered images and using graph-based belief propagation for localization and planning.
tldr_zh: ULVN 提出了一种统一的纯 RGB 框架，用于图像目标导航，通过从无序图像构建鲁棒的二维拓扑地图，并利用基于图的置信传播进行定位和规划，消除了对时间顺序或辅助传感器的依赖。
summary_zh: 图像目标导航是具身智能中的一项基础能力，但其实际部署受限于强先验假设。现有方法主要依赖时间有序的视频流或辅助传感器（如深度传感器、激光雷达）来维持空间一致性。这种时序与多模态依赖性严重制约了可扩展性，尤其在利用众包或预先录制的无序图像集部署机器人时。当移除时间先验后，当前方法面临严重的感知混淆、噪声关联以及灾难性地图构建失败等问题。为解决这一尚未充分探索的挑战，我们提出无序地标视觉导航（ULVN），一种无需时间与里程计先验的统一纯RGB框架。ULVN通过整合建图、定位与规划系统性地缓解误差累积。具体而言，它通过校准几何验证与最大生成森林优化，直接从非结构化图像构建鲁棒二维拓扑地图。在闭环执行中，ULVN摒弃时序启发式方法，采用基于图模型的置信传播滤波器，结合熵自适应融合实现全局定位与动态子目标规划。仿真与真实环境部署中的大量实验表明，ULVN显著优于现有最优方法。

title: Is Forward Prediction Enough? Physical State Grounding for JEPA World Models
summary: Learning structured and control-relevant latent representations remains a key challenge for world models. Recent JEPA-based world models learn action-conditioned predictive latent dynamics from observation sequences. However, their forward-prediction objectives do not explicitly enforce reliable identifiability of robot-centric physical state from individual latents or state changes from latent pairs, which can limit downstream planning and policy performance. We propose PSG-JEPA, a physically grounded JEPA world model that shapes its latent space with two complementary grounding objectives beyond forward prediction: grounding individual latents in robot proprioceptive state, and grounding latent pairs in multi-horizon joint-angle changes. Both objectives are applied only during training, leaving the inference architecture and computational cost unchanged. To comprehensively evaluate PSG-JEPA, we conduct experiments at three levels: (1) latent identifiability via probing, (2) goal-conditioned planning on frozen latents, and (3) policy learning in simulation and on a real robot. Experiments demonstrate that our PSG-JEPA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art latent world-model baselines at all three levels.
tldr: PSG-JEPA enhances JEPA world models by adding proprioceptive and joint-angle-change grounding objectives to improve latent identifiability and downstream planning/policy performance.
tldr_zh: PSG-JEPA通过添加本体感知和关节角变化的接地目标来增强JEPA世界模型，提高了潜在可识别性以及下游规划/策略性能。
summary_zh: 摘要：学习结构化且与控制相关的隐式表征仍是世界模型面临的关键挑战。基于JEPA的近期世界模型能从观测序列中学习动作条件化的预测性隐式动力学。然而，其前向预测目标并未明确强制要求从单个隐变量中可靠识别以机器人为中心的物理状态，或从隐变量对中识别状态变化，这可能会限制下游规划与策略性能。我们提出PSG-JEPA——一种物理约束的JEPA世界模型，通过在前向预测之外引入两种互补的约束目标来塑造其隐式空间：将单个隐变量与机器人本体感知状态对齐，将隐变量对与多时间尺度的关节角度变化对齐。这两种目标仅在训练阶段应用，推理架构与计算成本保持不变。为全面评估PSG-JEPA，我们在三个层面开展实验：(1)通过探测评估隐变量可识别性，(2)基于冻结隐变量的目标导向规划，(3)在仿真与真实机器人上的策略学习。实验表明，我们的PSG-JEPA在所有三个层面上均持续优于最先进的隐式世界模型基线方法。

title: CrossTracer: Cross-Embodiment Navigation via VLA Model Reasoning and Trace Residuals Adapting
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide strong semantic priors for robot navigation, but they often ignore embodiment-specific mobility constraints. A path that is semantically plausible for one robot may be physically infeasible for another. We propose CrossTracer, a hierarchical framework for cross-embodiment navigation through adaptive trace residuals. CrossTracer represents navigation plans as normalized image-plane waypoints, forming a unified pixel-space interface between semantic reasoning and physical grounding. First, Vision-Language Trace Proposer (VL-Tracer) adapts a pretrained VLA model to predict an initial navigation trace from egocentric observations and flexible goal specifications. Second, CE-Adapter refines this trace by predicting embodiment-conditioned residual corrections from visual traversability cues, robot identity, and the initial trace. To train the refinement module without costly manual annotation, Cross-Embodiment RRT* (CE-RRT*) converts panoptic segmentation into robot-conditioned traversability cost maps and generates cost-minimizing pixel-space traces. We evaluate CrossTracer on the NaviTrace benchmark, which tests whether a model can generate embodiment-consistent navigation traces from egocentric observations, language instructions, and robot embodiment types. CrossTracer achieves a total score of 45.68, outperforming the strongest evaluated general-purpose baseline, Gemini-2.5-Pro, by 10.01 points, corresponding to a 28.1% relative improvement. Real-world deployment on wheeled and legged robots further shows improved navigation success and execution efficiency.
tldr: CrossTracer is a hierarchical cross-embodiment navigation framework that combines a VLA model for initial trace proposal with an embodiment-adaptive residual refinement module, outperforming general-purpose baselines on the NaviTrace benchmark and demonstrating real-world deployment on wheeled and legged robots.
tldr_zh: CrossTracer 是一个层次化的跨本体导航框架，结合了 VLA 模型进行初始轨迹提议和本体自适应残差细化模块，在 NaviTrace 基准上优于通用基线，并在轮式和腿式机器人上实现了实际部署。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人导航提供了强大的语义先验，但往往忽略了具体形态特有的移动约束。对一种机器人而言语义合理的路径，对另一种机器人可能在物理上不可行。我们提出CrossTracer——一种通过自适应轨迹残差实现跨形态导航的分层框架。CrossTracer将导航计划表示为归一化的图像平面航点，在语义推理与物理基础之间构建统一的像素空间接口。首先，视觉-语言轨迹生成器（VL-Tracer）适配预训练的VLA模型，从自我中心观测和灵活的目标规约中预测初始导航轨迹。其次，跨形态适配器（CE-Adapter）通过视觉可通行性线索、机器人身份标识及初始轨迹，预测基于形态条件的残差修正量来优化该轨迹。为无需昂贵人工标注即可训练精修模块，跨形态快速随机扩展树（CE-RRT*）将全景分割转化为基于机器人状态的可通行性代价地图，并生成代价最小化的像素空间轨迹。我们在NaviTrace基准上评估CrossTracer，该基准测试模型能否从自我中心观测、语言指令和机器人形态类型中生成与形态一致的导航轨迹。CrossTracer总分达45.68分，比最强通用基线模型Gemini-2.5-Pro高出10.01分，相对提升28.1%。在轮式与足式机器人上的实际部署进一步证明了导航成功率和执行效率的提升。

title: MemWM: Memory-Augmented Text-Based World Model
summary: World models are increasingly used to support planning in agents by predicting how environment states evolve in response to agent actions. Yet fluent next-state predictions can still omit task-critical facts, corrupt product attributes, or apply incorrect transition rules. To address such systematic prediction errors, we introduce MemWM, a memory-augmented text-based world model. MemWM uses world memory, a curated memory bank of transition rules, state caches, and hard-to-predict facts, to condition next-state imagination. We evaluate factual state preservation with Structured State Fidelity (SSF), which scores predicted states through benchmark-specific facts and fields. Compared with SFT, memory-augmented training improves SSF by up to 206.3%. In the full planning setting, we keep the policy model frozen and provide policy-side world skill: retrieved task-level skills and step-wise corrective guidance for action selection. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, memory-augmented agents improve downstream success over an SFT-trained world-model agent, with up to a 65.4% relative gain. Sensitivity analyses further show that retrieved memory improves task success and efficiency under different memory and action-budget settings.
tldr: MemWM introduces a memory-augmented text-based world model that stores transition rules and hard-to-predict facts to improve next-state prediction fidelity and downstream task success in embodied agents.
tldr_zh: MemWM提出了一种基于记忆增强的文本世界模型，通过存储转换规则和难以预测的事实来提升下一状态预测的准确性，并提高下游任务的完成率。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
世界模型越来越多地被用于支持智能体规划，通过预测环境状态如何随智能体动作而变化。然而，流畅的下一状态预测仍可能遗漏任务关键事实、破坏产品属性或应用不正确的转换规则。为解决此类系统性预测错误，我们提出了MemWM——一种增强记忆的基于文本的世界模型。MemWM利用世界记忆（一个由转换规则、状态缓存和难以预测的事实组成的精选记忆库）来调节下一状态的想象。我们通过结构化状态保真度（SSF）评估事实状态的保留情况，该指标通过基准特定的事实和字段对预测状态进行评分。与SFT相比，增强记忆的训练使SSF提升了高达206.3%。在完整规划场景中，我们保持策略模型冻结，并提供策略侧的世界技能：检索到的任务级技能以及用于动作选择的逐步纠偏指导。在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld中，增强记忆的智能体相较于基于SFT训练的世界模型智能体，在下游任务成功率上实现了最高65.4%的相对提升。敏感性分析进一步表明，在不同记忆和动作预算设置下，检索到的记忆能够提升任务成功率和效率。

title: Capek 0.5: An Execution-Centric Vision-Language Model for Embodied Intelligence
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly serving as the reasoning core of embodied agents. Robot execution is inherently iterative: each action reshapes the scene and physical state, continually renewing what must be perceived, reasoned about, and verified. Meeting these demands requires complementary capabilities that differ in supervision signals, prediction formats, and verification criteria. Existing approaches typically develop these capabilities against isolated, task-specific objectives, leaving open how they should be organized and integrated around execution as a whole. We present Capek 0.5, an embodied vision-language model built around an execution-centric capability taxonomy. Rather than organizing training by datasets or tasks, the taxonomy groups embodied capabilities according to their functional roles throughout execution and comprises four capability families: Spatial Reasoning, Temporal Understanding, Action Guidance, and State Verification. Each capability is first acquired by a dedicated specialist through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards from a shared backbone, and the specialists are then consolidated into a single inference-time model through weight-space merging followed by routed policy-space distillation. We instantiate Capek 0.5 at the 2B and 35B-A3B scales and evaluate it from three complementary perspectives: comprehensive benchmark suites including Capek-StateBench, a new benchmark for state verification; a controlled study of capability retention from specialists to the unified model; and closed-loop evaluation in simulated embodied environments. Capek 0.5 improves the large majority of matched benchmark rows over its initialization, retains all four specialized capabilities in one checkpoint with quantified losses, and transfers to closed-loop embodied task execution.
tldr: Capek 0.5 proposes an execution-centric taxonomy for embodied VLMs, training four specialist capabilities via RL with verifiable rewards and merging them via weight-space merging and routed policy-space distillation, showing improved performance across benchmarks and closed-loop simulation.
tldr_zh: Capek 0.5 提出了一种以执行为中心的具身VLM能力分类法，通过可验证奖励的强化学习训练四个专家能力，并通过权重空间合并和路由策略空间蒸馏进行整合，在基准测试和闭环仿真中展现了改进的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型正日益成为具身智能体的推理核心。机器人执行本质上是迭代的：每个动作都会重塑场景与物理状态，不断更新需要感知、推理和验证的内容。满足这些需求需要具备在监督信号、预测格式和验证标准上各有不同的互补能力。现有方法通常针对孤立且任务特定的目标来开发这些能力，而未明确说明它们应如何围绕执行过程进行整体组织与整合。我们提出Capek 0.5，这是一个基于以执行为中心的能力分类体系构建的具身视觉-语言模型。该分类体系不按数据集或任务组织训练，而是根据各项能力在执行过程中的功能角色对其进行分组，包含四类能力：空间推理、时间理解、动作引导和状态验证。每项能力首先由专门的专家模型通过基于共享主干的可验证奖励进行强化学习来获得，随后通过权重空间合并及路由策略空间蒸馏，将这些专家模型整合为一个单次推理模型。我们在2B和35B-A3B规模上实例化Capek 0.5，并从三个互补角度对其进行评估：综合基准测试套件（包括用于状态验证的新基准Capek-StateBench）；从专家模型到统一模型的能力保持受控研究；以及模拟具身环境中的闭环评估。Capek 0.5在其初始化基础上提升了绝大多数匹配基准行的性能，在单个检查点中保留了所有四种专家能力并具有量化的损失，同时可迁移至闭环具身任务执行。

title: UniJEPA: A Unified Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Task-Agnostic Visual World Modeling
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have emerged as a principled framework for self-supervised learning of world models in compact latent spaces, yet existing methods are fragmented: some predict masked parts of a single image in latent space (I-JEPA), others learn to predict global photometric transformations (Image World Models), while video-scale JEPAs predict future temporal states and are post-trained for action-conditioned planning (V-JEPA~2, DINO-World, DINO-WM). These objectives are treated as distinct recipes with separate encoders, predictors, and anti-collapse regularizers, hindering a single model from unifying image-level and video-level world modeling. We present UniJEPA, a unified JEPA that jointly learns photometric prediction (image-level transformations) and temporal prediction (video-level next-state dynamics) in one shared latent space. A single end-to-end objective, composed of a next-embedding prediction loss and a Gaussian regularizer, yields a provably anti-collapse encoder-predictor pair trainable from raw pixels without EMA, stop-gradient, or pre-trained encoders. We show that the same latent space supports controllable abstraction: photometric prediction learns invariant structure while temporal prediction learns equivariant dynamics. After action-conditioned post-training on offline trajectories, UniJEPA enables zero-shot planning by treating goal features as prediction targets. On image, video, and control benchmarks, UniJEPA matches or surpasses task-specific JEPAs while requiring a single loss hyperparameter, and plans up to tens of times faster than generative world models at comparable accuracy.
tldr: UniJEPA unifies image-level and video-level joint-embedding predictive architectures into a single, self-supervised world model with a shared latent space, enabling zero-shot planning after action-conditioned post-training.
tldr_zh: UniJEPA 将图像级和视频级的联合嵌入预测架构统一为单个自监督世界模型，共享潜在空间，在动作条件后训练后支持零样本规划。
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）已成为在紧凑潜空间中自监督学习世界模型的基础框架，但现有方法较为分散：有的在潜空间中预测单张图像的掩蔽部分（I-JEPA），有的学习预测全局光度变换（图像世界模型），而视频级JEPAs则预测未来时间状态，并通过后训练实现动作条件规划（V-JEPA~2、DINO-World、DINO-WM）。这些目标被视为不同的方案，各自采用独立的编码器、预测器和抗坍缩正则化器，阻碍了单一模型统一图像级与视频级世界建模。我们提出UniJEPA——一种统一JEPA，能够在共享潜空间中联合学习光度预测（图像级变换）与时间预测（视频级下一状态动态）。单一端到端目标函数由下一嵌入预测损失和高斯正则化器组成，可证明地产生抗坍缩的编码器-预测器对，且无需指数移动平均（EMA）、停止梯度或预训练编码器即可从原始像素训练。我们证明同一潜空间支持可控抽象：光度预测学习不变结构，而时间预测学习等变动态。在离线轨迹上完成动作条件后训练后，UniJEPA通过将目标特征视为预测目标实现零样本规划。在图像、视频和控制基准测试中，UniJEPA在仅需单一损失超参数的情况下达到或超越任务特定JEPAs的性能，并以相当精度实现比生成式世界模型快数十倍的规划速度。

title: Addressable Memory for Video World Models
summary: We study visual persistence in interactive video world models. These models rely on a Key-Value (KV) cache as a growing visual memory to carry forward previously generated frames. However, we find that models can no longer reliably address stored content once rollouts extend beyond the training horizon, because temporal Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) offsets then fall outside the range seen during training and the model struggles to retrieve the relevant visual information through attention. Moreover, naively compressing the cache in the RoPE-rotated space corrupts memory by averaging together incompatible positional phases. To address this, we propose WorldTrace, a training-free memory framework for long-horizon visual persistence. WorldTrace keeps compressed memory addressable by assigning each summary slot a distinct, in-distribution virtual position. Within this addressable cache, we study two memory compression approaches: WorldTrace-Field compresses history for temporal coherence, while WorldTrace-Landmark stores verbatim scene traces at detected transitions for episodic recall. We further introduce LoopBench, a benchmark evaluating whether a compressed cache can reconstruct a previously visited scene after a long detour. WorldTrace-Field improves temporal consistency by +15.5%, and WorldTrace-Landmark improves episodic recall by +19.5% on LoopBench, extending visually persistent generation without retraining.
tldr: This paper proposes a training-free memory framework for video world models that uses compressed, addressable key-value caches to improve long-horizon visual persistence, with applications in interactive environments.
tldr_zh: 本文针对视频世界模型提出一种无需训练的记忆框架，通过可寻址的压缩键值缓存提升长期视觉持久性，适用于交互环境。
summary_zh: 我们研究了交互式视频世界模型中的视觉持久性问题。这类模型依赖键值缓存作为不断扩展的视觉记忆，以继承先前生成的帧。然而，我们发现当推演长度超出训练范围时，模型不再能可靠地定位已存储的内容，这是因为时序旋转位置编码的偏移量此时已超出训练阶段所见范围，导致模型难以通过注意力机制检索相关视觉信息。更严重的是，在旋转位置编码旋转空间中直接压缩缓存，会因平均处理不相容的位置相位而导致记忆损坏。为解决此问题，我们提出了WorldTrace——一种无需训练的长时视觉持久记忆框架。WorldTrace通过为每个摘要槽分配独立的分布内虚拟位置，使压缩后的记忆仍保持可寻址性。在此可寻址缓存中，我们研究了两种记忆压缩方法：WorldTrace-Field通过压缩历史信息保持时序连贯性，WorldTrace-Landmark则在检测到的场景切换点存储逐帧场景轨迹以实现情景回忆。我们进一步引入LoopBench基准测试，评估压缩缓存能否在长程绕行后重建先前访问的场景。在LoopBench上，WorldTrace-Field将时序一致性提升15.5%，WorldTrace-Landmark将情景回忆准确率提升19.5%，两者均可在无需重新训练的情况下扩展视觉持久生成能力。

title: Beyond Myopic World Models: Long-Horizon End-to-End Training for Direct Future Prediction
summary: World models are expected to support imagination over extended temporal horizons, yet most are still trained through local few-step prediction objectives and deployed by recursively rolling out their own predictions. This creates a fundamental mismatch: few-step losses optimize local transition fidelity, while long-horizon prediction depends on how errors and gradients propagate through the entire trajectory. As a result, transitions with different downstream influence on the endpoint are treated uniformly during training, and small local errors are amplified through recursive inference. We argue that long-horizon accuracy is better achieved by optimizing directly, through an end-to-end endpoint prediction objective. To instantiate this paradigm, we introduce the Direct Prediction World Model (DPWM), a non-recursive architecture that compresses an action sequence of arbitrary length into a single embedding and predicts the endpoint observation in a single forward pass. This design avoids recurrent rollout in both prediction and gradient propagation, making long-horizon end-to-end training practical at horizons where unrolled autoregressive training becomes unstable. Empirically, DPWM substantially improves long-horizon endpoint prediction over recursive world-model baselines on continuous-control and pixel-based benchmarks, with larger gains as the prediction horizon increases. We further show that recurrent baselines benefit similarly when retrained with the same long-horizon endpoint objective, supporting our central claim that the training objective, rather than the particular backbone choice, is the main driver of long-horizon prediction accuracy. Our results suggest that world models can benefit from being trained and evaluated at the temporal scales where they are ultimately used, shifting the focus from local transition modeling toward long-horizon predictive accuracy.
tldr: Proposes DPWM, a non-recursive world model that directly predicts endpoint observations from action sequences via end-to-end training, significantly improving long-horizon prediction accuracy over recursive baselines.
tldr_zh: 提出DPWM，一种非递归世界模型，通过端到端训练直接从动作序列预测终点观测，在长时域预测精度上显著优于递归基线。
summary_zh: 世界模型本应支持对长时间跨度的想象推演，但目前大多数模型仍通过局部几步预测目标进行训练，并通过递归迭代自身预测结果进行部署。这造成了一个根本性错配：几步损失优化的是局部状态转移的保真度，而长时域预测则取决于误差和梯度在整个轨迹中的传播方式。因此，在训练过程中，对终点状态下游影响不同的状态转移被同等对待，而微小的局部误差则通过递归推理被不断放大。我们认为，通过端到端的终点预测目标进行直接优化，能更好地实现长时域精度。为实例化这一范式，我们提出了直接预测世界模型（DPWM），这是一种非递归架构，可将任意长度的动作序列压缩为单一嵌入，并通过单次前向传播预测终点观测。该设计在预测和梯度传播过程中均避免了递归展开，使得在展开式自回归训练变得不稳定的时域长度上，长时域端到端训练成为可能。实验表明，在连续控制和基于像素的基准测试中，DPWM相比递归式世界模型基线大幅提升了长时域终点预测性能，且预测时域越长收益越大。我们进一步证明，当递归基线使用相同的长时域终点目标重新训练时，也能获得类似的性能提升，这支持了我们的核心论点：长时域预测精度的主要驱动力是训练目标本身，而非特定的主干网络选择。我们的结果表明，世界模型应在最终应用的时域尺度上进行训练和评估，从而将关注点从局部状态转移建模转向长时域预测精度。

title: Learning Fault-Tolerant Locomotion with Adaptive Gait Timing
summary: Hardware failures require legged robots to rapidly reorganize coordination and gait timing to maintain stability and mobility. This is particularly challenging for larger quadrupeds, where increased mass and tighter actuation limits reduce the feasibility of aggressive, high-frequency compensation strategies often observed on smaller platforms. In this work, we propose a deep reinforcement learning approach for fault-tolerant locomotion under actuator power loss. The method employs an asymmetric actor-critic architecture in which the critic has access to privileged information during training, while the actor learns to reconstruct a corresponding latent representation from proprioceptive observations. We introduce a latent-alignment loss that encourages consistency between actor and critic representations. Additionally, we augment the action space with a learnable gait frequency parameter, enabling adaptive gait timing in response to terrain variations and actuator degradation without predefined faulty-leg strategies. The approach is validated in high-fidelity simulation on uneven terrain and real-world experiments on flat ground using a 68 kg quadruped robot.
tldr: This paper presents a deep reinforcement learning approach for fault-tolerant quadruped locomotion under actuator power loss, using an asymmetric actor-critic with latent alignment and a learnable gait frequency parameter.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种深度强化学习方法，用于在执行器功率损失下实现容错四足运动，采用具有潜在对齐的非对称演员-评论家架构和可学习的步态频率参数。
summary_zh: 硬件故障要求足式机器人快速重组协调步态与节律，以维持稳定性与机动性。这对大型四足机器人尤其具有挑战性——其更大的质量和更严苛的作动极限，使得通常在小型平台上采用的激进高频补偿策略难以实现。本文提出一种基于深度强化学习的容错运动方法，用于应对作动器功率损失。该方法采用非对称的演员-评论家架构，在训练过程中评论家可获取特权信息，而演员则通过本体感受观测学习重建对应的隐层表征。我们引入隐层对齐损失项以强化演员与评论家表征间的一致性。此外，通过引入可学习的步态频率参数扩展动作空间，使机器人能够根据地势变化和作动器退化自适应调整步态节律，而无需预设故障腿策略。该方法在68kg级四足机器人的高保真仿真（复杂地形）及真实场景（平坦地面）实验中均得到验证。

title: Representation Handoffs for OpenArm-Based Laboratory Mobile Manipulation
summary: Open-source robotics and foundation models have lowered the barrier to embodied AI, yet language-guided laboratory automation still requires reliable alignment from instructions and observations to safe actions. This field report presents an OpenArm-based mobile manipulation prototype for laboratory-style tasks, built by integrating dual OpenArm manipulators with a mobile base, vertical slide, RGB-D sensing, lidar-based mapping, ROS2/MoveIt execution, and profile-defined skill interfaces. The system is organized around representation handoffs: natural language requests are constrained into registered skill calls, sensor observations are grounded into maps and object poses, object priors provide role and skill constraints, and runtime bindings compile validated skills into executable motion goals. We use dry-run traces and startup checks to evaluate this integration path, showing how the prototype exposes missing calibration, incomplete object assets, and unfinished real-scene visual grounding as explicit deployment blockers. These intermediate representations serve as practical debugging interfaces for integrating language, perception, planning, and robot safety in embodied systems.
tldr: This field report presents an OpenArm-based mobile manipulation prototype for laboratory tasks, using representation handoffs to align language, perception, planning, and safety, with dry-run traces and startup checks revealing deployment blockers.
tldr_zh: 本领域报告介绍了一个基于OpenArm的实验室移动操作原型，通过表征交接对齐语言、感知、规划与安全，并利用预演追踪和启动检查暴露部署障碍。
summary_zh: 开源机器人技术和基础模型降低了具身人工智能的门槛，但语言引导的实验室自动化仍需将指令与观测可靠地对齐为安全动作。本领域报告介绍了一种基于OpenArm的移动操作原型系统，专为实验室类任务设计。该系统通过集成双OpenArm机械臂、移动底座、垂直滑轨、RGB-D传感、基于激光雷达的建图、ROS2/MoveIt执行框架以及配置文件定义的技能接口构建而成。系统围绕表征交接进行组织：自然语言请求被约束为已注册的技能调用；传感器观测结果被映射至地图与物体位姿；物体先验知识提供角色与技能约束；运行时绑定将验证通过的技能编译为可执行运动目标。我们采用空运行轨迹追踪与启动校验评估该集成路径，揭示了原型系统如何将缺失的标定参数、不完整的物体资产库、以及未完成的真实场景视觉定位作为显式部署障碍暴露出来。这些中间表征可作为集成语言、感知、规划与机器人安全性的实用调试接口，服务于具身系统开发。

title: Detection and Ranging of Transient Extrinsic Contacts Based on 6D Dynamic Tactile Sensing
summary: Delicate manipulation often involves transient and subtle collisions between a grasped object and the environment. While the human hand localizes these contacts effortlessly thanks to superior tactile sensitivity, robotic systems often lack the requisite resolution to acquire the information necessary for motion planning, resulting in clumsy manipulation or even task failure. Here, we propose transient extrinsic contact detection and ranging (TECDAR), a simple yet fast and efficient method for detecting and ranging extrinsic contact of grasped objects. Our design of gripper tips employs dynamic tactile sensing leveraging a single 2.5$\times$3 mm 6D inertial measurement unit. The sensor captures sub-millisecond tip deformations at a 7 kHz sampling rate, but operating on a data stream of only 84 KB/s. High bandwidth and compact data size enable the system to rapidly detect and localize contact between grasped objects and their surroundings. Specifically, fusing tactile data with robot pose via an extended Kalman filter enables fast and precise localization of extrinsic contact, reaching millimeter-level accuracy within 180 ms. Experimental results demonstrate that the system achieves an average localization accuracy of approximately 7\,mm in both line-contact and point-contact localization tasks. Furthermore, this near-instantaneous localization enables the robot to rectify its trajectory on a millisecond scale, facilitating precise tool manipulation and enhanced perception of complex environments purely through tactile exploration and mapping. We envision such techniques advancing the future of robotics across domains requiring delicate manipulation, including precision assembly, surgical assistance, and autonomous exploration in touch-dominant environments. Project page: humitlab.github.io/TECDAR/
tldr: This paper introduces TECDAR, a method that uses a 6D IMU embedded in gripper tips for high-speed, high-bandwidth dynamic tactile sensing to detect and localize transient extrinsic contacts during robotic manipulation, achieving millimeter-level accuracy within 180 ms.
tldr_zh: 本文提出TECDAR方法，通过在夹爪尖端嵌入6D惯性测量单元实现高速、高带宽的动态触觉传感，用于检测和定位机器人操作中瞬态的外部接触，在180毫秒内达到毫米级精度。
summary_zh: 精细操作通常涉及抓取物体与环境之间短暂且微妙的碰撞。尽管人类手部凭借卓越的触觉灵敏度能够轻松定位这些接触，但机器人系统往往缺乏获取运动规划所需信息的必要分辨率，从而导致操作笨拙甚至任务失败。在此，我们提出瞬态外部接触检测与测距（TECDAR）方法，这是一种简单、快速且高效的抓取物体外部接触检测与测距技术。我们的夹爪尖端设计采用动态触觉传感技术，仅需一个2.5×3毫米的六维惯性测量单元。该传感器以7 kHz采样率捕获亚毫秒级的尖端形变，但数据处理带宽仅为84 KB/s。高带宽与紧凑数据量使系统能够快速检测并定位抓取物体与周围环境的接触。具体而言，通过扩展卡尔曼滤波器将触觉数据与机器人位姿融合，可快速精准地定位外部接触，在180毫秒内达到毫米级精度。实验结果表明，该系统在线接触与点接触定位任务中均实现了约7毫米的平均定位精度。此外，这种近乎瞬时的定位能力使机器人能在毫秒尺度上修正轨迹，从而仅通过触觉探索与映射即可实现精准工具操作及对复杂环境增强感知。我们预计此类技术将在需要精细操作的各个领域推动机器人学发展，包括精密装配、手术辅助以及以触觉为主导环境中的自主探索。项目页面：humitlab.github.io/TECDAR/

title: AutoIntervene: Calibrated Intervention for Action-Chunking Imitation Learning Policies
summary: Action-chunking visuomotor policies learn from demonstrations and improve temporal consistency by predicting short action sequences rather than single-step commands. Yet perception errors and execution drift can move the robot outside the demonstration distribution, while the policy continues to produce smooth action chunks that are inconsistent with the observed state. We present AutoIntervene, an online framework that selectively transfers control between an action-chunking policy and an operator during deployment. AutoIntervene evaluates proposed chunks against a visual-action support memory built from successful task executions, combining visual similarity with consistency between proposed and reference actions. Phase-local support governs policy-to-operator transfer within the current task phase, whereas global support governs the return to policy control after operator recovery. We calibrate separate switching thresholds for the two directions from empirical quantiles of evaluation-level scores on held-out expert demonstrations, avoiding direct manual tuning of score cutoffs. Intervention segments retained from successful rollouts target learner-induced states and provide corrective supervision for subsequent policy updates. Experiments on real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show higher post-adaptation task success and lower operator-control time than manual intervention. Videos and additional results are available at https://aus.bot/research/autointervene/.
tldr: AutoIntervene is an online framework that selectively transfers control between an action-chunking policy and an operator during robot deployment, using a visual-action support memory with calibrated switching thresholds to improve task success and reduce operator time in real-world bimanual manipulation.
tldr_zh: AutoIntervene 是一个在线框架，在机器人部署期间通过在动作分块策略与操作员之间选择性转移控制，利用视觉-动作支持记忆和校准的切换阈值，在真实双臂操作任务中提高了任务成功率并减少了操作员控制时间。
summary_zh: 行为分块视觉运动策略通过预测短动作序列而非单步指令来从示范中学习，并提升时间一致性。然而，感知错误和执行漂移可能导致机器人偏离示范分布，而策略仍会持续生成与当前观测状态不一致的平滑动作块。我们提出AutoIntervene，一种在线框架，在部署期间选择性地在动作分块策略与操作员之间切换控制权限。AutoIntervene基于成功任务执行构建的视觉-动作支持记忆，结合视觉相似性以及候选动作与参考动作之间的一致性，对候选动作块进行评估。阶段局部支持控制当前任务阶段内策略向操作员的转移，而全局支持则决定操作员恢复后策略控制的回归。我们从留出的专家示范中评估分数的经验分位数，分别为两个方向校准独立的切换阈值，避免直接手动调整分数截断值。从成功执行中保留的干预片段针对学习者诱发的状态，为后续策略更新提供修正监督。在真实世界双人操作任务上的实验表明，相比人工干预，该方法在适应后任务成功率更高且操作员控制时间更短。视频及更多结果请访问https://aus.bot/research/autointervene/。

title: Spatiotemporal Agility: Time-Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Guided Dynamic Quadrupedal Interception
summary: Legged robots require robust agility to perceive and interact with complex and dynamic environments within a constrained time. However, most existing quadruped locomotion works rely on velocity-tracking policy, which struggle to reach precise targets within strict temporal constraints. Moreover, integrating real-time perception with agile locomotion for highly dynamic targets remains challenging due to sensor latency and processing delays. To concretely study and benchmark such agility in dynamic settings, we introduce a challenging ball-catching task for legged robots. This paper proposes an integrated framework that combines a vision module for landing point and time prediction with a direct position and time conditioned RL locomotion policy, instead of intermediate velocity commands. Beyond the method design, this work presents a system-level contribution that completes real-time robotic interception system that integrates multi-camera perception, online trajectory prediction, low-latency target communication, and sim-to-real locomotion control into a closed-loop deployment pipeline. By explicitly predicting the future spatial-temporal target, our approach mitigates perception latency during dynamic interception. We conducted extensive ball-catching experiments for the legged robot. Through comparative experiments against a velocity-tracking baseline, our direct target-conditioned approach achieves a higher success rate in catching balls with predicted landing spots within 2 meters and flight times between 0.8 and 1.2 seconds. This shows that the robot has successfully completed the dynamic ball-catching task under our tested setup. Furthermore, our policy exhibits a smaller performance gap after deployment, suggesting improved sim-to-real behavior in these trials.
tldr: This paper proposes a framework combining vision-based landing point/time prediction with a position-and-time-conditioned RL locomotion policy for dynamic quadrupedal ball-catching, demonstrating improved success rates and sim-to-real transfer compared to velocity-tracking baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合视觉落点/时间预测与位置-时间条件强化学习运动策略的四足机器人动态接球框架，相比速度跟踪基线方法提高了成功率并改善了仿真到现实的迁移效果。
summary_zh: 腿式机器人需要具备强大的敏捷性，以便在有限时间内感知复杂动态环境并与之交互。然而，现有绝大多数四足运动研究依赖于速度跟踪策略，难以在严格时间约束下精确抵达目标。此外，将实时感知与敏捷运动整合以应对高度动态目标仍具挑战性，原因在于传感器延迟与处理延时。为了在动态环境中具体研究与评估此类敏捷性，我们针对腿式机器人引入了一项具有挑战性的接球任务。本文提出一种集成框架，将用于落点与时间预测的视觉模块与直接基于位置-时间条件的强化学习运动策略（而非中间速度指令）相结合。除方法设计外，本工作还贡献了系统层面的成果：构建了完整的实时机器人拦截系统，将多摄像头感知、在线轨迹预测、低延迟目标通信以及从仿真到现实的运动控制整合为闭环部署流水线。通过显式预测未来时空目标，我们的方法缓解了动态拦截过程中的感知延迟。我们针对腿式机器人开展了大量接球实验。与基于速度跟踪的基线方法相比，我们的直接目标条件方法在预测落点半径2米内、飞行时间0.8至1.2秒的接球任务中获得了更高成功率。这表明在测试设定下，机器人成功完成了动态接球任务。此外，我们的策略在部署后性能差距更小，表明这些试验中从仿真到现实的行为迁移得到了改善。

title: R2S-EGO: Dual-Proxy Refinement for Sparse-Capture Real-to-Sim
summary:
Real-to-sim (R2S) depends on scene representations that render observations along robot ego trajectories, yet dense multi-view capture limits per-environment real-image capture-count efficiency, and sparse human capture can
  leave behavior-scoped robot views under-supported. Camera-controlled synthesis can fill missing views, but its use in R2S requires behavior-admissible queries and capture-anchored structural conditioning. We present R2S-EGO,
  which couples a simulator-derived robot proxy that represents the behavior-scoped executable query domain with a capture-anchored geometry proxy that supplies scene-specific structural conditions. Within this domain, fixed-
  budget selection targets current support deficits for which geometry support is available. The generated observations are assimilated as pseudo-observations to refine the visual asset, while real captures remain anchors. The
  fused geometry proxy also supplies the scene collision surface, which is refreshed between rounds. Together, these updates refine the existing simulation scene while its robot dynamics and control stack stay fixed. Across 48
  frozen Unitree G1 ego views in three Replica scenes, six-view R2S-EGO reaches 19.062 dB PSNR, compared with 14.226 dB for the strongest reported R2S baseline. Across five paired policy-training seeds, R2S-EGO achieves 82.5%
  +/- 6.8% real-G1 sitting success, compared with 10.0% +/- 10.5% for GaussGym.
tldr: R2S-EGO introduces a dual-proxy refinement framework that uses a simulator-derived robot proxy and a capture-anchored geometry proxy to generate pseudo-observations for real-to-sim scene reconstruction from sparse captures, improving visual quality and downstream robot policy success on a real Unitree G1 robot.
tldr_zh: R2S-EGO 提出了一种双代理细化框架，通过模拟器导出的机器人代理和捕获锚定的几何代理生成伪观测，从稀疏捕获中重建仿真场景，提升了视觉质量和真实 Unitree G1 机器人的下游策略成功率。
summary_zh: 实到仿真（R2S）依赖于能够沿机器人自视轨迹渲染观测数据的场景表征，然而密集多视角采集限制了每场景真实图像采集数量的效率，稀疏的人工采集则可能导致行为范围内的机器人视角支撑不足。相机控制合成可填补缺失视角，但其在R2S中的应用需要行为可接受的查询和基于采集锚点的结构条件约束。我们提出R2S-EGO方法，该方法将表征行为可执行查询域的仿真衍生机器人代理，与提供场景特定结构条件的采集锚点几何代理相结合。在该域内，固定预算选取策略针对当前几何支撑可用的支撑缺陷区域进行优化。生成的观测数据作为伪观测被同化以优化视觉资产，而真实采集数据保持锚点地位。融合后的几何代理同时提供场景碰撞表面，并在轮次间进行刷新。这些更新共同优化现有仿真场景，同时保持机器人动力学与控制堆栈不变。在三个Replica场景中48个冻结的Unitree G1自视图像上，六视角R2S-EGO达到19.062 dB峰值信噪比，而最强R2S基线报告值为14.226 dB。在五组配对策略训练种子中，R2S-EGO实现了82.5%±6.8%的真实G1坐姿成功率，相比之下GaussGym仅为10.0%±10.5%。

title: SoRoMoX: Fast, Differentiable, and Parallelizable Soft Robot Models
summary: Reduced-order models based on Cosserat-rod theory are now well established, and modeling theory is no longer the primary bottleneck in soft-robot control. Their implementations, however, do not support the differentiable, GPU-parallel, and control-oriented workflows that underpin advanced rigid-robotics applications. Here, we fill this gap with SoRoMoX (Soft Robot Models in JAX), a fully numerical, JIT-compilable Python/JAX framework. SoRoMoX implements articulated, Piecewise Constant Strain, and Variable Strain models through a unified, control-ready interface that provides inertia matrices, gravitational and elastic forces, Jacobians, and their derivatives. To our knowledge, it is the first rod/strain-based soft-robot modeling framework that runs directly on GPUs and is end-to-end differentiable with respect to states, inputs, and parameters. Sequential CPU rollouts are up to 18.1x faster than state-of-the-art alternatives, while GPU-parallel rollouts increase throughput by up to 234.6x. This performance enables workflows that were previously impractical or impossible: static-equilibrium system identification with 66% lower marker RMSE; residual-force learning with a further 64% reduction; computed-torque tracking with RMSE reduced by a factor of approximately 500 relative to model-free PD; control-gain optimization with up to 62% lower loss than untuned gains; safety-constrained control using high-order control barrier functions to keep the peak contact force within a prescribed 5 N bound, compared with 33.5 N without the safety constraint; and reinforcement-learning policy training up to 7x faster than a CPU PyElastica discrete-rod baseline through massively parallel rollouts.
tldr: SoRoMoX is a GPU-accelerated, end-to-end differentiable soft robot modeling framework in JAX that achieves order-of-magnitude speedups over existing CPU-based tools, enabling efficient system identification, tracking control, safety-constrained control, and reinforcement learning.
tldr_zh: SoRoMoX 是一个基于 JAX 的 GPU 加速、端到端可微分的软体机器人建模框架，相比现有 CPU 工具实现数量级加速，支持高效的系统辨识、跟踪控制、安全约束控制和强化学习。
summary_zh: 基于Cosserat杆理论的降阶模型现已成熟，建模理论不再是软体机器人控制的主要瓶颈。然而，这些模型的实现尚不支持支撑先进刚体机器人应用的微分可计算、GPU并行及面向控制的工作流程。本文通过SoRoMoX（基于JAX的软体机器人模型）填补这一空白——这是一个完全数值化、支持JIT编译的Python/JAX框架。该框架通过统一且面向控制的接口实现了关节式、分段常应变及变应变模型，能够提供惯性矩阵、重力与弹性力、雅可比矩阵及其导数。据我们所知，这是首个可直接在GPU上运行、且对状态、输入和参数实现端到端可微分的基于杆/应变的软体机器人建模框架。顺序CPU推演速度相比最先进方案提升最高18.1倍，而GPU并行推演吞吐量提升最高234.6倍。该性能使此前不切实际或无法实现的工作流程成为可能：静态平衡系统辨识使标记点均方根误差降低66%；残差力学习进一步降低64%；计算力矩跟踪的均方根误差相比无模型PD降低约500倍；控制增益优化损失相比未调谐增益降低高达62%；通过高阶控制障碍函数实现安全约束控制，将峰值接触力限制在规定的5N范围内（无安全约束时为33.5N）；通过大规模并行推演，强化学习策略训练速度相比基于CPU PyElastica离散杆基线的方案提升最高7倍。

title: LyEvO: Lyapunov-Guided Evolutionary Optimization for Safe and Robust Sim-to-Real Policy Learning
summary: Training controllers that are safe and robust in simulation, and systematically assessing their readiness for real-world deployment, remain key challenges in sim-to-real transfer. To address this, we propose LyEvO, a physics-grounded framework that combines constrained Evolutionary Optimization and Statistical Model Checking (SMC)-based verification with Lyapunov-based stability analysis. Leveraging prior knowledge of the system dynamics, LyEvO uses Lyapunov analysis to compute an initial candidate stability region. An iterative loop then uses operational scenarios drawn from this region to jointly optimize and statistically verify a policy, and subsequently expands the region's boundaries based on the verification outcome. This integrated procedure provides a practical criterion for assessing deployment readiness. We evaluate LyEvO on Cartpole and 3D Quadrotor benchmarks through extensive simulations and targeted real-world experiments, demonstrating safe and robust sim-to-real transfer.
tldr: LyEvO combines Lyapunov-based stability analysis with constrained evolutionary optimization and statistical model checking to produce safe and robust policies that can be reliably transferred from simulation to real-world robots.
tldr_zh: LyEvO 将基于李雅普诺夫的稳定性分析与约束进化优化及统计模型检查相结合，生成安全鲁棒的策略，并可靠地从仿真迁移到真实机器人。
summary_zh: 在仿真环境中训练安全鲁棒的控制器，并系统评估其实际部署就绪程度，仍是仿真到现实迁移中的关键挑战。为此，我们提出LyEvO——一个融合物理约束的进化优化、基于统计模型检验（SMC）的验证以及李雅普诺夫稳定性分析的框架。利用系统动力学的先验知识，LyEvO通过李雅普诺夫分析计算初始候选稳定域。随后，基于此稳定域生成的运行场景，迭代循环对策略进行联合优化与统计验证，并根据验证结果扩展稳定域边界。这一集成流程为评估部署就绪性提供了实用准则。我们分别在Cartpole和3D四旋翼基准测试上，通过大量仿真实验与针对性真实世界实验对LyEvO进行评估，验证了其能够实现安全鲁棒的仿真到现实迁移。

title: Dueling World Models: Advantage-Style Action Channels for Common-Mode Distractor Rejection
summary: Latent world models plan by predicting future states from an action, but when a scene contains motion the agent does not control, they quietly go action-blind: predictions for different actions become indistinguishable even as the training loss keeps improving. Existing remedies suppress this distraction with reconstruction, task reward, or auxiliary objectives, each adding machinery or assumptions. We show that a minimal alternative suffices, borrowed from the dueling decomposition of value into a state baseline and an action advantage: in latent dynamics, subtracting a prediction's mean effect over actions cancels whatever the actions share--the action-independent variation where distractors live--leaving a clean, controllable channel, with no reward, no reconstruction, and no distractor-specific auxiliary loss. Because this is only a subtraction at readout time, it applies unchanged to any action-conditioned world model, including frozen pretrained ones. Across a gridworld, synthetic generators with known factors, distracting continuous control, and natural-pixel Atari, the isolated channel recovers the agent's own effect where entangled predictors fail, with nuisance leak indistinguishable from zero; applied post hoc it surfaces an action channel in off-the-shelf models that their raw readouts miss, and it converts into goal-reaching control in the gridworld. We prove the cancellation is exact in finite samples for both discrete and sampled action sets, and we state its measured boundary--distractors whose motion tracks the action--together with the remaining limitations in the appendix.
tldr: The paper proposes a minimal, reward-free method for latent world models to reject action-independent distractor motion by subtracting the mean prediction over actions, enabling clean action-conditioned control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种极简、无需奖励的方法，通过在潜在世界模型中减去动作上的平均预测，来消除与动作无关的干扰运动，从而获得干净的动作条件控制通道。
summary_zh: 潜在世界模型通过从动作预测未来状态来进行规划，但当场景中存在智能体无法控制的运动时，它们会悄然丧失对动作的敏感性：即使训练损失持续改善，针对不同动作的预测也会变得难以区分。现有解决方案通过重构、任务奖励或辅助目标来抑制这种干扰，但每种方法都引入了额外的机制或假设。我们证明，一个极简的替代方案便已足够——借鉴了价值分解为状态基线（state baseline）与动作优势（action advantage）的对偶分解思想：在潜在动力学中，减去预测在动作上的平均效应，即可消除动作共享的部分——即干扰因素所在的、与动作无关的变化——从而保留一个干净、可控的通道，且无需奖励、重构或针对干扰的辅助损失。由于这仅在读取时刻执行减法操作，它可无修改地适用于任何以动作为条件的世界模型，包括冻结的预训练模型。在网格世界、具有已知因子的合成生成器、含干扰的连续控制任务以及自然像素的Atari游戏中，该分离出的通道能够恢复智能体自身的动作效应（而纠缠的预测器则会失败），且干扰泄漏与零无显著差异；事后应用该机制，可揭示现成模型中原始输出未能捕捉到的动作通道，并在网格世界中将其转化为达成目标的控制能力。我们证明，对于离散动作集和采样动作集，该抵消在有限样本下是精确的，并在附录中给出了其可测量的边界——即其运动轨迹与动作同步的干扰——以及其余局限性。

title: TaskSense: Focusing on What Matters in World Models
summary: World models for visual control typically learn compact latent states by reconstructing observations, implicitly encouraging representations to preserve information across the entire visual input. However, task-relevant content often occupies only a small fraction of the observation, while background clutter and distractors consume valuable representational capacity. This mismatch between visual reconstruction and control objectives biases latent representations to model task-irrelevant visual content, diluting learning signals for control-relevant features and severely degrading downstream performance under visual distractions. We introduce TaskSense, a task-centric world modeling framework that enforces task relevance before latent encoding through a differentiable stochastic spatial attention mechanism conditioned on the previous latent state. To steer attention toward control-relevant regions, we augment training with an auxiliary inverse-dynamics objective. Rather than reconstructing the full observation, the world model reconstructs only the attended regions, encouraging latent representations to preserve task-relevant information while discarding irrelevant visual content. The decoder is further conditioned on the sampled attention map, enabling consistent reconstruction despite stochastic attention. Compared with the DreamerV3 baseline, TaskSense maintains competitive performance on the DeepMind Control Suite while consistently outperforming DreamerV3 on the Distracting Control Suite, demonstrating substantially improved robustness to visual distractions. Qualitative analysis further confirms that the learned attention, guided by inverse-dynamics supervision, consistently localizes control-relevant regions while suppressing irrelevant visual content.
tldr: TaskSense introduces a differentiable stochastic spatial attention mechanism and inverse-dynamics objective to make world models focus on task-relevant regions, discarding distractors and improving robustness in visual control.
tldr_zh: TaskSense 通过可微随机空间注意力机制和逆向动力学目标，使世界模型聚焦于任务相关区域，丢弃干扰信息，提升了视觉控制的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 用于视觉控制的世界模型通常通过重构观测来学习紧凑的潜在状态，这隐式地促使表征保留整个视觉输入中的信息。然而，与任务相关的内容通常仅占观测的一小部分，而背景杂波和干扰物则消耗了宝贵的表征容量。这种视觉重构与控制目标之间的不匹配，使得潜在表征偏向于建模与任务无关的视觉内容，从而稀释了控制相关特征的学习信号，并在存在视觉干扰的情况下严重降低下游性能。我们提出TaskSense，这是一种以任务为中心的世界建模框架，通过一种可微分的随机空间注意力机制（该机制以先前的潜在状态为条件），在潜在编码之前强制实现任务相关性。为引导注意力聚焦于控制相关区域，我们通过辅助逆动力学目标来增强训练过程。世界模型并非重构完整观测，而仅重构被关注的区域，从而促使潜在表征保留与任务相关的信息，同时丢弃无关的视觉内容。解码器进一步以采样的注意力图为条件，使得即使在随机注意力机制下也能实现一致的重构。与DreamerV3基线相比，TaskSense在DeepMind控制套件上保持了具有竞争力的性能，同时在干扰控制套件上始终优于DreamerV3，展现出对视觉干扰显著增强的鲁棒性。定性分析进一步证实，在逆动力学监督引导下学习到的注意力能够一致地定位控制相关区域，同时抑制无关的视觉内容。

title: Identifying the Key Biomechanical Features of Movement Adaptation during Exoskeleton-Assisted Locomotion
summary: The understanding of natural human adaptation during exoskeleton-assisted locomotion - particularly individual differences in adaptation behaviors and temporal progression - remains limited. In this work, we investigate temporal evolution of biomechanical variables to uncover participant-specific adaptation strategies across different exoskeleton-assisted locomotion scenarios. Nine healthy participants performed treadmill walking under three conditions: without an exoskeleton, with exoskeleton active ankle assistance, and with exoskeleton zero-torque. Lower limb kinematics, inter-joint coordination, and metabolic cost of transport (MCoT) were analyzed at both the group and individual levels. Results indicate that adaptation is gradual and highly individualized, with substantial variability in convergence timing and movement patterns across participants. Kinematic adaptation occurred asynchronously across lower limb, with larger fluctuations during the swing phase. Metabolic responses were heterogeneous and often non-convergent, highlighting the limitations of steady-state assumptions commonly adopted in the literature. These findings emphasize the importance of individual-level, temporal evolution analyses for understanding adaptation dynamics in exoskeleton use.
tldr: This paper analyzes the temporal evolution of biomechanical variables during exoskeleton-assisted locomotion, revealing highly individualized and asynchronous adaptation patterns, challenging steady-state assumptions.
tldr_zh: 本文分析外骨骼辅助行走过程中生物力学变量的时间演变，揭示了高度个体化且不同步的适应模式，挑战了稳态假设。
summary_zh: 在借助外骨骼辅助运动过程中，人体自然适应机制——特别是适应行为的个体差异及时间进程——仍认知有限。本研究通过分析生物力学变量的时间演变规律，揭示不同外骨骼辅助运动场景下受试者特有的适应策略。九名健康受试者在三种条件下进行 treadmill 行走：不穿戴外骨骼、穿戴外骨骼主动踝关节助力、以及穿戴外骨骼零力矩模式。研究分别从群体与个体层面分析了下肢运动学、关节间协调性及代谢能耗（MCoT）。结果表明适应过程呈渐进式且高度个体化特征，不同受试者的收敛时间与运动模式存在显著差异。下肢运动学适应呈现非同步性，摆动相期间波动幅度更大。代谢反应呈现异质性且常不收敛，凸显了文献中普遍采用的稳态假设的局限性。这些发现强调了个体层面时间演变分析对于理解外骨骼使用中适应动力学的重要性。

title: Benchmarking and Reasoning Distillation of Large Language Models for Feedback Controller Design in Complex Dynamical Systems
summary: Although remarkable capabilities have been demonstrated by Large Language Models (LLMs) across scientific domains, feedback controller design remains underexplored. Existing benchmarks focus mainly on linear single-Degree-of-Freedom (DoF) systems and large API-hosted models, leaving performance on complex controller-design tasks and feasibility for edge deployment unclear. To address these limitations, we introduce the Complex Dynamics-to-Control Benchmark for Large Language Models (CoDyControlBench), comprising 132 system configurations across five evaluation dimensions: number of DoF, system type, coupling level, damping regime, and controller type. Six state-of-the-art LLMs were evaluated over three independent runs, including three commercial models (GPT, Gemini, and Claude) and three open-source models (GLM, DeepSeek, and Qwen). GPT achieved the highest design success rate at 94.8\%, whereas Qwen showed the lowest rate at 50.0\%. Across the benchmark dimensions, DoF and controller type exhibited the largest model-averaged variations in design success, with success-rate ranges of 36.3\% and 17.6\%, respectively, exceeding those associated with system type, coupling level, and damping regime. Comparison of GPT and Qwen showed that their performance gap arose mainly from the control-design knowledge, particularly gain selection and the use of transient-limiting mechanisms. For edge deployment, a specialized 1.5B-parameter model was developed through reasoning distillation. The reasoning-distilled model outperformed the answer-distilled and base model on CoDyControlBench, maintained stable performance across 1-6 DoFs, and achieved successful traget tracking in all three physical trials on a pneumatic-artificial-muscle-driven robotic arm. These results establish a benchmark baseline and highlight the potential of lightweight, edge-deployable controller-design models.
tldr: This paper introduces CoDyControlBench, a benchmark for LLM-based feedback controller design in complex dynamical systems, evaluates six LLMs, and develops a 1.5B-parameter reasoning-distilled model that succeeds in physical trials on a pneumatic-artificial-muscle-driven robotic arm.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了 CoDyControlBench 基准，用于评估大型语言模型在复杂动态系统反馈控制器设计中的表现，并通过推理蒸馏开发了一个 1.5B 参数轻量模型，在气动人工肌肉驱动的机械臂上成功进行了物理实验。
summary_zh: 尽管大型语言模型已在科学领域展现出显著能力，但其在反馈控制器设计方面的应用仍有待探索。现有基准主要聚焦于线性单自由度系统及大型API托管模型，对复杂控制器设计任务的性能表现及边缘部署可行性尚未明确。针对上述局限，我们提出面向大型语言模型的复杂动力学到控制基准（CoDyControlBench），涵盖五个评估维度（自由度数量、系统类型、耦合程度、阻尼特性及控制器类型）下的132种系统配置。研究评估了六种先进大型语言模型（含三种商业模型GPT、Gemini、Claude及三种开源模型GLM、DeepSeek、Qwen），每项模型经三次独立测试。GPT以94.8%的设计成功率位居首位，而Qwen以50.0%的成功率垫底。在基准测试维度中，自由度数量与控制器类型的设计成功率呈现最大模型平均变异幅度（成功率范围分别为36.3%和17.6%），显著超过系统类型、耦合程度及阻尼特性带来的差异。GPT与Qwen的对比分析表明，二者性能差距主要源于控制设计知识差异，特别是增益选择与瞬态限制机制的应用能力。针对边缘部署需求，通过推理蒸馏技术开发了专用1.5B参数模型。该推理蒸馏模型在CoDyControlBench上的表现优于答案蒸馏模型及基础模型，在1-6自由度范围内保持稳定性能，并在气动人工肌肉驱动机械臂的三项物理实验中均实现成功轨迹跟踪。这些结果建立了基准基线，并突显了轻量化、可边缘部署的控制器设计模型的应用潜力。

title: Vernata: Self-Supervised Learning of LiDAR Point Representations
summary: LiDAR serves as a primary sensing modality for robots operating in outdoor environments. However, the performance of deep learning models in this domain is severely limited by the scarcity of labeled data, a direct result of the high cost of 3D annotation. Self-supervised learning addresses this scarcity by learning general-purpose features from unlabeled data. In this work, we present a multi-modal, multi-teacher distillation framework for self-supervised learning on outdoor LiDAR point clouds. Building upon the Sonata architecture, we introduce Vernata, consisting of three extensions: sparse view augmentation to improve robustness against varying point densities, a memory bank mechanism to stabilize resource-constrained training, and cross-modal distillation utilizing dense, high-resolution 2D image features to enable fine-grained semantic guidance. We evaluate our method on the GrandTour, TartanGround, and Waymo datasets, as well as data collected from our own robotic platforms. Our experiments demonstrate a significant performance improvement over Sonata baselines, yielding mIoU scores of 54.7 on TartanGround (+5.9 points, +12.1%) and 57.1 on Waymo (+7.3 points, +14.7%). Finally, we show that the self-supervised approach maintains strong performance even in reduced-modality settings (lacking color or normals), achieving competitive mIoU scores of 49.4 and 50.2 on the respective datasets.
tldr: Vernata is a multi-modal, multi-teacher self-supervised learning framework for outdoor LiDAR point clouds, incorporating sparse view augmentation, memory bank, and cross-modal distillation to improve downstream segmentation without labeled data.
tldr_zh: Vernata 是一个多模态、多教师的自监督学习框架，用于户外 LiDAR 点云，通过稀疏视图增强、记忆库和跨模态蒸馏在无标签数据上提升下游分割性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
激光雷达是户外环境机器人感知的主要传感方式。然而，该领域中深度学习模型的性能因标注数据稀缺而严重受限——这直接源于三维标注的高昂成本。自监督学习通过从无标注数据中学习通用特征来应对这一数据匮乏问题。本文提出了一种面向户外激光雷达点云自监督学习的多模态、多教师蒸馏框架。在Sonata架构基础上，我们引入Vernata，其包含三项扩展：稀疏视图增强以提升对不同点密度的鲁棒性、用于稳定资源受限训练的记忆库机制，以及利用高分辨率二维图像特征实现细粒度语义引导的跨模态蒸馏。我们在GrandTour、TartanGround、Waymo数据集以及自有机器人平台采集的数据上评估了该方法。实验表明，与Sonata基线相比，我们的方法获得显著性能提升：在TartanGround数据集上mIoU达到54.7（提升5.9点，增幅12.1%），在Waymo数据集上达到57.1（提升7.3点，增幅14.7%）。最后，我们证明该自监督方法即使在缺少色彩或法向量的简化模态场景下仍能保持强劲性能，在相应数据集上分别取得了49.4和50.2的竞争性mIoU得分。

title: When Coordination Becomes a Threat: Communication Attacks in LLM-Controlled Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as high-level planners in embodied multi-robot systems, enabling robots to interpret natural language instructions and coordinate executable actions. Yet, this growing reliance on LLM planners also raises security concerns. Prior work has focused mainly on individual robots, while communication risks in multi-robot collaboration remain insufficiently understood. Existing multi-robot studies are further limited to preliminary analysis under the Decentralized Multi-agent System (DMAS) architecture, so it remains unclear whether these risks persist across other common communication architectures and how attacker access settings shape their propagation. To fill this gap, we formulate two communication attacks corresponding to distinct attacker access settings: the External Entry Point Attack and the Privileged In-System Attack. We evaluate both attacks across DMAS, HMAS-1, and HMAS-2 using three LLMs and five embodied multi-robot tasks. Results show that unsafe information can turn into unsafe actions across all three architectures: DMAS reaches a 96.7\% entry endorsement rate and a 100\% post endorsement activation rate, HMAS-1 reaches a 97.8\% unsafe action success rate, and HMAS-2 triggers 88.3\% of task defined unsafe action slots. To mitigate risks from trusted information flow, we introduce the Claim Provenance and Verification (CPV) Gate, which verifies communicated claims before downstream reuse and reduces the violation rate from 70.0\% to 36.6\%.
tldr: This paper investigates communication attacks in LLM-controlled multi-robot systems, proposing two attack settings and a mitigation gate to reduce unsafe actions.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了LLM控制的多机器人系统中的通信攻击，提出了两种攻击设置以及一种缓解门控机制以降低不安全动作。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被用作具身多机器人系统中的高层规划器，使机器人能够理解自然语言指令并协调可执行动作。然而，这种对LLM规划器日益增长的依赖也引发了安全问题。以往研究主要关注单个机器人，而多机器人协作中的通信风险尚未得到充分理解。现有的多机器人研究进一步局限于去中心化多智能体系统（DMAS）架构下的初步分析，因此尚不清楚这些风险是否在其他常见通信架构中持续存在，以及攻击者访问设置如何影响其传播。为填补这一空白，我们针对两种不同的攻击者访问设置，设计了两种通信攻击：外部入口点攻击和特权系统内部攻击。我们在DMAS、HMAS-1和HMAS-2三种架构上，使用三种LLM和五种具身多机器人任务对这两种攻击进行了评估。结果表明，不安全信息可在所有三种架构中转化为不安全动作：DMAS的条目认可率达到96.7%，认可后激活率达到100%；HMAS-1的不安全动作成功率达到97.8%；HMAS-2触发了88.3%的任务定义不安全动作槽位。为减轻可信信息流带来的风险，我们引入了声明来源与验证（CPV）门控机制，该机制在下游复用前对通信声明进行验证，并将违规率从70.0%降至36.6%。

title: SyncSBC: Decentralized Swarm Behavior Prediction for Synchronized Autonomous Control
summary: Robot swarms utilize many independent limited-sensing agents to produce complex emergent behaviors without requiring centralized control. However, little research explores how agents can infer swarm-level behavior from purely local perception, a capability critical for detecting faults and behavior changes. In this paper, we introduce Synchronized Swarm Behavior Classification (SyncSBC), which combines improvements in machine learning and distributed consensus to classify collective swarm behavior and synchronize swarm decision-making in an entirely decentralized manner. We show that SyncSBC achieves high classification accuracy and low synchronization delay, making it suitable for real-world deployment. Finally, we use SyncSBC to demonstrate two promising swarm applications on real robots where we show that swarms utilizing SyncSBC can accurately identify anomalies in robot behavior and autonomously coordinate collective changes in swarm behavior. Videos, code and supplemental experiments are available at https://sites.google.com/view/sync-sbc/home.
